Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Machine Learning Engineer, you will create and implement machine learning techniques, frameworks, and tools that enable the efficient discovery and utilization of state-of-the-art machine learning solutions over a broad set of technology verticals or designs. Qualcomm Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the world of mobile, edge, auto, and IOT products through machine learning hardware and software.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

Daily Duties:
Collaborate in the design, development, and delivery of AI-powered capabilities that advance Nimbus product objectives and address customer needs.

Contribute to the development, evaluation, and deployment of AI and Generative AI solutions supporting network optimization, Digital Twin technologies, and other strategic AI-driven products.

Work closely with engineering, product, and domain experts to translate business and customer requirements into practical AI-enabled solutions.

Communicate technical concepts, project status, and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Stay current with emerging AI technologies, industry trends, and best practices, identifying opportunities to apply them across Nimbus initiatives.

Apply sound software engineering and AI development practices to ensure scalable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions.

Minimum Qualifications:

Working knowledge of modern AI/ML concepts, including model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization.

Experience delivering AI-enabled software products or features from concept through production deployment.

Familiarity with AI concepts, agentic AI frameworks, knowledge management systems, and other LLM-based applications.

Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
 

Preferred Qualifications:

1+ years of hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, or deploying AI/ML models.

M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.

Experience with cloud-based AI platforms, MLOps practices, data engineering, or large-scale data processing systems.

Familiarity with telecommunications, wireless networking, Digital Twin technologies, network automation, or intelligent network-management systems.

Experience with Generative AI, agentic systems, multi-agent frameworks, LLM applications, or AI-assisted software development.

Demonstrated interest in emerging AI technologies and their application to real-world engineering and product challenges.
